decision: supported: optional is a candidate in these fixtures; inconclusive whether early registration is necessary beyond them
hypothesis: Optional prevented late prose relayout in both tested delivery fixtures. These data do not demonstrate that early registration is necessary or that switching the complete Google/CJK font bundle is sufficient. All-loaded and registered does not itself prove the chosen face rendered in document text.
